risk_dashboard.model_cn: 固定beta + 目标仓位的暴露估算；不是实盘风控执行器

quality_policy.note_cn: 弱代理不进默认买入；主题代理权重×0.7；回测中 proxy 正收益折扣、负收益放大

backtest.label_cn: 组合 Flex v2（行业指数代理回顾重放，非ETF可复制业绩）
backtest.execution: 默认strict_evidence：无历史尾盘时点证据则T+1开盘；收盘价尾盘代理仅属单独假设场景

backtest_protocol.price_path: event-driven account ledger; open executions and daily close marks
backtest_protocol.right_censoring: entries follow observed events without inspecting future window completeness; positions still open at sample end retain diagnostic valuation and are excluded from completed trade counts and win rates
backtest_protocol.core_tail: strict_evidence is the default; missing historical tail evidence defers to T+1 open
backtest_protocol.core_tail_quality: historical EOD confidence is not point-in-time tail evidence
backtest_protocol.tail_assumption: eod_close_proxy assumes a T close fill, not a verified executable tail fill
backtest_protocol.cost: account fills charge explicit buy/sell costs, including rebalances
backtest_protocol.proxy: baseline uses raw industry-index proxies, not tradable ETF performance; return haircuts are separate stress scenarios
backtest_protocol.observe: observe-only satellite sleeve uses 0.25 production scale
backtest_protocol.satellite_risk_exit: after 3 completed sessions, detect basket return <= -3% or >= 4% at EOD and execute at next open including the gap
backtest_protocol.oos: retrospective holdout starts flat on 2024-01-01; not parameter-independent
backtest_protocol.walk_forward: expanding fixed-policy temporal-stability windows; no in-fold tuning
backtest_protocol.prospective: BLOCKED_REQUIRES_POINT_IN_TIME_ARCHIVE; backfilled observations are retrospective replay, not strict prospective validation
backtest_protocol.missing_execution_prices: incomplete execution suppresses performance; diagnostic counts and issues remain visible
